display_name: PAMF 时域、PA 与频谱统计完整实验
description: 226 rows: separate PA IQ and spectral statistics, eleven data settings, five training conditions, PL permutation and E200; direct and matched DURA readouts.

roles.U_s: source IQ; TX=-1; only PL/SSL rows

permissions.regime: Fixed supervised, ordinary PL, or full Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; CE structure and E200 are supervised only
permissions.query_use: Both target populations and every registered view/readout freeze before independent CPU truth-last scoring
permissions.claim_scope: Exposed development benchmark; original external-method objective and augmentation differences disclosed

checkpoint.initialization: 211 scratch models; 15 same-contract completed branch models reused; 528 external results reused
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Existing source roles, seed, frozen checkpoint, prediction and score checked per reused row
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Explicit source, no target feedback, source contract and readout checks; no new G training
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final epoch; all registered rows retained; no target feedback

expected_artifacts: 211 new frozen models and associated predictions and independent scores
